title: Create a counterexample library for “shortest means safest.”
uncertainty: Route quantities to about 1e-6 relative (RK4 step 0.04; scipy/sympy agreement when available); witness gaps are O(0.1-4); sphere margins within 1e-10 of delta (checked to 1e-3 relative).
unresolved_assumptions: Witnesses show the statements are false in general; they do not rank routes for any application.
Route sets are fan-search results, stable under doubling the density but not proven complete (the saddle's uniqueness is the Cartan-Hadamard theorem, not the search).
Small |j_head(L)| is not robustness: the targeting condition number 1/|j_head(L)| grows as q approaches a conjugate point, and a route with negative focus margin is not locally minimizing.
